The '''''Baronial''-class [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]''' was a craft commissioned by the [[Draay Trust]] for the [[Jedi Covenant]]. It could seat four passengers and a single pilot although additional benches could be added for more passengers or cargo.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> One of these yachts was used by [[Lucien Draay]] to escape the ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]'' at the end of the [[First Battle of Omonoth]].<ref name="Faraway-KOTOR Countdown #2: Just-Asked-Questions, The Finale!">{{Faraway|url=blog/2010/02/16/kotor-countdown-2-just-asked-questions|text=KOTOR Countdown #2: Just-Asked-Questions, The Finale!}}</ref>
